name: Real-Time Procedural Volumetric Fire
definition: A method for producing real-time procedural volumetric fire using hardware acceleration, Improved Perlin Noise, and a realistic particle simulation to create vibrant volumetric fire with bi-directional environmental macro-interactivity.
summary: Real-Time Procedural Volumetric Fire is a hardware-accelerated method that constructs a 3D lattice around a central curve to render vibrant fire, avoiding sprite artifacts and high computational costs.
